Subtracting twice the even-indexed terms from the full harmonic sum gives
$$\frac pq=\sum_{j=1}^{1319}\frac1j-\sum_{j=1}^{659}\frac1j=\sum_{j=660}^{1319}\frac1j.$$
Pair $j$ with $1979-j$. Each pair equals $1979/[j(1979-j)]$. The integer 1979 is prime (trial division by primes up to $\sqrt{1979}<45$ suffices), and every denominator factor is less than 1979. Thus the sum is $1979u/v$ for integers $u,v$ with $1979\nmid v$. From $pv=1979uq$, primality gives $1979\mid p$.
